bundle.longDescription: CW-BY4CWY is a Morse code communication assistant that converts CW signals into readable text in real time. Built for amateur radio club education. Based on web-deep-cw-decoder by e04, with DeepCW neural decoding engine. Licensed under AGPL-3.0.
